reply_text: Gideon, I replied in #inc-vtg-hartford. You first reported the kiosks offline at 10:42 AM on 3 Aug. At that point the guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard. The channel doesn't say more about the guard until Mateo's 11:03 AM message, which reports the guard checking in trailer 8836 after kiosk 1 came back.
